# Deepseek Family for Github Copilot Chat

- llms.txt index for AI coding agents
- Base URL: https://api.deepseek.com
- Auth: Bearer $DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
- Models: deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro (1M context, 384K max output)
- Compatibility aliases: deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp temporarily route to deepseek-flash
- Thinking: { type: "enabled" | "disabled" } + reasoning_effort: "none" | "low" | "high" | "max"
- Vision: deepseek-flash accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP images in user messages via Chat Completions content blocks
- CoT: returned as reasoning_content (must be passed back across tool-call turns)
- Balance: GET /user/balance → { is_available, balance_infos[] }
- See docs/deepseek-api.md for details
